$comment: Shared, versioned Claude Code config for steelshelf. The Stop hook runs
the same suite Gitea Actions runs, so a turn cannot end red locally and then
fail in CI. Logic lives once in a shared test-gate.sh (symlinked
into ~/.claude/scripts/); the command it runs is .claude/test-command. On a
machine without that script the hook is a no-op.
Session-specific permissions belong in the gitignored settings.local.json.
